q_45367.question_text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)
q_45367.reasoning:
Let me analyze this systematically.

## (a) Time left until resolution

Today is August 21, 2026. NVIDIA will report Q2 FY2027 results on August 26, 2026. That's approximately **5 days** until the actual earnings release, meaning this question resolves very imminently with near-certainty.

## (b) Most likely outcome and why

NVIDIA has already issued **official forward guidance of $91.0 billion ± 2%** for Q2 FY2027 on May 20, 2026. This means:
- **Guided range: $89.2 billion to $92.8 billion** (89.0 × 0.98 to 91.0 × 1.02)
- **Midpoint: $91.0 billion**

With only 5 days until the actual earnings release, the "forward guidance" being asked about is essentially already known and published. The question is asking what NVIDIA's guidance will be, but they've already provided it.

The most likely outcome is that the actual reported Q2 FY2027 revenue will fall within or near the guided range of $89.2B-$92.8B, with analyst consensus at $91.9B (very close to the midpoint of guidance).

## (c) What would push the value lower?

- If there were unexpected weaknesses in data center demand that became apparent in the final days before earnings (unlikely given how recent the guidance is)
- If China-related restrictions or geopolitical factors emerged that weren't anticipated in the May guidance
- If customer order cancellations or deferrals occurred in the final weeks

However, with guidance issued only ~3 months prior and the earnings date just 5 days away, the company would already have substantial visibility into actual results.

## (d) What would push the value higher?

- Better-than-expected demand, particularly from enterprise/cloud customers ramping up AI infrastructure
- Higher ASP (average selling prices) than anticipated
- Stronger international demand offsetting any China headwinds
- The company conservatively guided and beat its own guidance

Historically, NVIDIA has shown a tendency to exceed guidance when the AI boom is accelerating.

## (e) Base rate or historical reference values

The research shows:
- NVIDIA's official guidance: **$91.0 billion ± 2%** = **$89.2B to $92.8B range**
- Wall Street analyst consensus: **~$91.9 billion** (within the guided range, slightly above midpoint)
- This implies ~100% YoY growth from $46.7B in Q2 FY2026

No specific historical base rates are provided in the materials for how often NVIDIA beats/misses guidance, but the analyst consensus sitting slightly above the guidance midpoint suggests modest upside expectations.

## Analysis

Given that:
1. Official guidance was issued very recently (May 20, 2026)
2. We are only 5 days away from actual results
3. The company would have had ~3 months to refine their estimate
4. Analyst consensus is at $91.9B, comfortably within the guided range
5. The range provided ($99.5B-$115.5B) extends well above guidance, suggesting the question asker expects possible upside surprises

The most probable outcome is that actual Q2 FY2027 revenue will be reported in the range of **$89-$93 billion**, clustering around **$91-$92 billion**.

For the distributions across the broader range given:
- **10th percentile**: ~$88.5B (slightly below guidance floor, representing a mild miss)
- **50th percentile (median)**: ~$91.5B (at/slightly above midpoint of guidance and analyst consensus)
- **90th percentile**: ~$94.5B (above guidance ceiling but representing stronger-than-guided execution)

The range extending to 99.5-115.5B seems to allow for tail scenarios of exceptional outperformance, but core probability mass should remain tightly clustered around official guidance.

q_45367.research_text:
NVIDIA's forward guidance for Q2 FY2027 revenue, issued on May 20, 2026, predicts $91.0 billion, plus or minus 2% [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/). This guidance explicitly excludes any Data Center compute revenue from China [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/).

Wall Street analysts' average estimate for Q2 FY2027 revenue is around $91.9 billion, which falls within NVIDIA's guided range (ceiling near $92.8 billion, floor near $89.2 billion) [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/). This implies a year-over-year revenue doubling from $46.7 billion in the same quarter last year [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/). The sequential revenue growth is projected to slow to about 11% from 20% in Q1 FY2027 [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/). NVIDIA will report its Q2 FY2027 results on August 26, 2026 [news.ifyouspent.com](https://news.ifyouspent.com/en/news/nvidia-earnings-what-to-watch-august-2026).
